description: Experience the vibrant flavors of Karachi with this exquisite Fish Fry. Marinated in a blend of aromatic spices and deep-fried to golden perfection, it offers a crispy exterior and succulent, flaky interior. This dish is a true celebration of Pakistani coastal cuisine, perfect for any seafood lover.

ingredients.notes: cut into steaks or large pieces, washed and pat dry

instructions.title: Prepare the Fish
instructions.text: Ensure your fish pieces are thoroughly washed and patted completely dry with paper towels. This helps the marinade adhere better and prevents splattering during frying. Make a few shallow slits on each fish piece for better spice penetration.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade Paste
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, crushed carom seeds, garam masala powder, and salt. Add the gram flour and rice flour. Gradually add 2-3 tablespoons of water, mixing well to form a thick, smooth paste. The paste should be thick enough to coat the fish without dripping.

instructions.title: Marinate the Fish
instructions.text: Generously apply the prepared spice paste all over the fish pieces, ensuring it gets into the slits. Make sure every piece is thoroughly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 1-2 hours, to allow the flavors to meld.

instructions.title: Prepare for Frying
instructions.text: Heat oil in a deep frying pan or wok over medium-high heat. To test if the oil is hot enough, drop a tiny bit of marinade into it; it should sizzle immediately. Do not overcrowd the pan; fry the fish in batches to maintain oil temperature and ensure even cooking.

instructions.title: Fry the Fish
instructions.text: Carefully place the marinated fish pieces into the hot oil. Fry for about 4-6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through. The exact time will depend on the thickness of your fish. Ensure the fish is crispy on the outside and flaky on the inside.

instructions.title: Drain and Serve
instructions.text: Once cooked, remove the fish from the oil using a slotted spoon and place it on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges, a sprinkle of chaat masala, and your favorite green chutney or raita. Enjoy this authentic Karachi style delight!

tips: Always pat your fish completely dry before marinating; this prevents the marinade from becoming watery and ensures a crispier fry.
For an extra kick, add a pinch of dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi) to the marinade, or a little red food coloring for a vibrant restaurant-style look.
Serve your Karachi Style Fish Fry immediately after frying to enjoy its maximum crispiness. A side of thinly sliced onion rings and fresh coriander adds to the experience.
